messages:
Lina Tran: Heads-up — autopay failed for AcmeSoft (acct_8832). Invoice INV-2031 for $12,750 is due today and the gateway returned an expired_card decline. Need a quick plan: retry cadence, payment link, or temporary hold?

Javier Morales: digging into gateway response now. here's the payload we got:
```json
{"status":"failed","error":{"type":"card_error","code":"card_declined","decline_code":"expired_card","message":"Card has expired"},"payment_method":"pm_1Jx...","customer":"cus_J3k..."}
```

Priya Nair: pinged the customer. They said they have a new corporate virtual card but asked if we can provide a secure payment link — also asked if due date can shift by 3 days while they update billing.

Sam O'Leary: We can offer a hosted pay link (single-use) and shift due date. Finance needs to OK a 3-day grace and whether we put a temporary credit hold to avoid service interruption.

billing-bot: Autopay retry policy: next attempt scheduled in 24h (attempts remaining: 2). Dunning emails queued per policy.

Javier Morales: Recommend: suppress automatic retries/dunning while CS sends link, generate single-use hosted payment page (no CVV storage), and optionally apply a temporary $2,000 credit to keep them online. Manual capture via Stripe is possible but risk of additional declines without CVV.

Lina Tran: I approve a $2k temporary safety credit for AcmeSoft given enterprise contract. Also OK to shift due date +3 days and pause dunning while we await payment. No late fee waiver required but waive auto late penalty for this one.

Priya Nair: Customer confirms new card exp 04/26 but tokenization fails with 3DS required. They asked if we can accept card over the phone — legal said we cannot store CVV. I'll send the single-use link and advise 3DS flow.

Sam O'Leary: Finance approves single-use link only. @billing-bot please flag INV-2031 with metadata: hold=payment_update and suppress dunning.

billing-bot: Invoice INV-2031 flagged: hold=payment_update. Dunning suppressed. Autopay retries paused.

Javier Morales: Payment link created: https://pay.redwood.com/t/AB12 (single-use, expires in 72h). I set a reminder to attempt manual collect only after customer authorizes via the link.

Lina Tran: Action items recap — CS (Priya) send link and confirm when card is updated; Finance (Javier) create link and stand by for manual collect; Finance approved $2k temporary credit and +3 day due date. Leaving this open until payment posts. :thumbsup:

Priya Nair: Sent link to customer and logged in CRM. Customer acknowledged — will try 3DS flow today. I'll update once complete.

Javier Morales: noted. will revert invoice to normal billing and remove hold once payment settles.

Lina Tran: Great, thanks everyone.
